title: HR screening bot — AI CV reading
subtitle: AI Product & System Canvas · 2026-10-19 · built with the wizard

verdict.label: GO → offline MVP experiment
verdict.summary: AI costs ~$0.0003–0.0009 per CV vs ~$1.00 of HR time, so economics are not the issue. Candidate screening is a high-risk use under the EU AI Act: run the offline bake-off now, and put the compliance baseline in place before Shadow on real candidates.

pattern: Structured output — per-criterion extraction with verbatim quotes; bucket computed by code

1.text: 2 clients × 5 vacancies × 100–250 responses/month; HR spends ~5 min per response (3 on the CV) — 40–100 h/month per client; volume set to grow 5–10×. Lever: revenue growth.

2.text: Primary: ≥40% of next 10–20 clients pay for the AI tier. Leading: HR time ≤2 min/response (from 5). Stop: after 6 weeks <40% time saved or HR opens ≥80% of CVs.

3.text: In-house HRs (SMB, IT hiring) without an expensive ATS: a CV check against must-haves with quotes instead of reading every CV — ~3 min saved per response. Manager pays.

4.text: One-time: build 30–40 h × $30, compliance baseline. Ongoing: inference <$35/month at 25K CVs, audits. Unit ≤$0.01/CV. AI tier +$100; payback ~2–6 months.

5.text: 1 client, highest-volume vacancy, free 6-week pilot → both clients → new clients after gates. Gates: ≤2 min/response, pilot converts to paid, quality holds.

6.text: "AI CV check" block in the existing candidate card: ✓/✗/? per must-have with a CV quote, 2-line summary, "AI suggestion" label. Added by a batch every 4 h.

7.text: Extract text → strip protected attributes → one LLM call per CV → code verifies quotes and computes the bucket. HR-written criteria only. Risks: false ✗, misread facts, prompt injection.

8.text: Quality: per-criterion accuracy ≥90%, false-contradicted ≤3%, 100% valid quotes, reject agreement ≥95%, EN/DE/ES gap ≤5 pp. Performance: within one 4 h batch, ≥99% valid outputs.

9.text: Golden set ~120 CVs (past + synthetic DE/ES). Shadow 2 weeks / 150 responses → Assist. No Auto: AI never decides. Back to Shadow if false ✗ >3% in a weekly sample.

10.text: Invite / Reject (two taps), Open CV, Flag AI error. "AI suggestion — decision is yours", "AI check pending". Candidate notice at /start + human-only review. 3-month retention.

11.text: Where does extracted CV text live (today: Telegram file id), and how does the 3-month deletion run?

12.text: How does the golden-set eval rerun on every prompt/model change; is the model+prompt version logged per card?

13.text: Batch API vs scheduled job; EU-region zero-retention provider (Token Factory or pinned gateway)?

14.text: How does a new prompt version reach one vacancy before all (canary by vacancy)?

15.text: Alerts on false-✗ rate, Flag-AI-error spikes and batch failures; decision logs kept for audit.

next_step: Offline bake-off on ~120 labelled CVs (EN/DE/ES): frontier bar vs Gemini 2.5 Flash vs gpt-oss-120b vs a larger multilingual open model. Then the compliance baseline (DPA, DPIA, candidate notice, logging) before Shadow.
